main_text.l: נֶאֱחָזוֹ possessores facti, (cum א, quiesc. in Cholem, ut in fut.Kal, pro נֶאֱחָזוּ,) præt.Niph.
& comedimus eum, fut. Kal, 1. pl. parag. & aff. R. אָכַל.
נֶאֱמָן firmus est, נֶאֱמָנָה firma est, נֶאֱמָנִי, & נֶאֱמָנוּ fideles sunt, præt.Niph, 3. f. m. & f. & 3. pl. Rad. אָמַן.
נֶאֱמָן fidus, נֶאֱמָנָה, & נֶאֱמֶנֶת fidelis, נֶאֱמָנִים, נֶאֱמָנִי fidi, & נֶאֱמָנוֹת fidæ, &c. Part. Niph. f. & pl. m. & fæm. Rad. אָמַן nutrivit.
לְנֶאֱמָנִים fidelibus, Part. Niph. pl. m. præf. vel est No. pl. m. præf. à Rad. אָמַן.
נֶאֱמַר dictum fuit, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. R. אָמַר
נֶאֱמַר dicemus, fut. Kal, 1. pl. R. אָמַר.
נֶאֱנַח suspiravit, נֶאֱנְחוּ suspirârunt, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. & 3. pl. R. אָנַח.

page.notes: Hebrew words are copied from the scan, but the vowel points and some consonants are small and blurred, so the Hebrew forms are best readings and should be checked against the page. The grey smudge over the right-hand middle of the page is show-through and was left out. The page number 277 is printed at top right and is clear. The catchword "ge-" and the signature "Mm 3" are at the foot.
